item.title: Caminho da Nazaré
item.description:
Another post where I wanted to write a lot, but it ended up being a dump of beautiful photos from a hike I did with two of my friends, at the beginning of this month. The trail we hiked is known as the Caminho da Nazaré, in the Leiria region, Portugal. It was a 54 km hike that’s normally split into three days, but we did it in two.

Day 1 - Nazaré to Porto de Mós

On the first day, we hiked ~30 km from the coastal town of Nazaré to Porto de Mós.

item.title: Camí de Picasso
item.description:
“The only journey is the one within.” - Rainer Maria Rilke(?)

Last month, between the 2nd and 5th of September, I hiked a trail known as the Camí de Picasso in Catalonia, Spain, over four days. Since I am currently a bit too lazy to write about the trail, I am leaving a trail of photos instead.

Day 1 - Guardiola de Berguedà - Saldes

Distance: 21.1 km. Elevation: +1,016 / −541 m.
